story.text: 전주에는 지하철이 없다. 대신 시내 곳곳을 촘촘히 잇는 버스가 있었다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-e-neun ji-ha-cheol-i eop-da. dae-sin si-nae got-got-eul chom-chom-hi it-neun beo-seu-ga iss-eot-da.
story.en: Jeonju has no subway. Instead, a dense network of buses connected every corner of the city.

story.text: '저기 정류장. 다음 버스가 우리가 탈 거야.' 하늘이 표지판을 가리키며 앞장섰다.
story.reading: 'jeo-gi jeong-nyu-jang. da-eum beo-seu-ga u-ri-ga tal geo-ya.' ha-neul-i pyo-ji-pan-eul ga-ri-ki-myeo ap-jang-seot-da.
story.en: "There's the bus stop. The next bus is ours." Haneul pointed at the sign and led the way.

story.text: 버스가 도착하자 그는 능숙하게 교통카드를 태그했다. '너도 찍어.' 나는 서둘러 카드를 댔다.
story.reading: beo-seu-ga do-chak-ha-ja geu-neun neung-suk-ha-ge gyo-tong-ka-deu-reul tae-geu-haet-da. 'neo-do jjik-eo.' na-neun seo-dul-leo ka-deu-reul daet-da.
story.en: When the bus arrived, he tapped his transit card without a second thought. "You too, tag it." I hurried to tap mine as well.

story.text: '다음 정류장에서 환승하면 시간이 더 빨라.' 창밖을 보던 하늘이 무심히 알려줬다.
story.reading: 'da-eum jeong-nyu-jang-e-seo hwan-seung-ha-myeon si-gan-i deo ppal-la.' chang-bakk-eul bo-deon ha-neul-i mu-sim-hi al-lyeo-jwot-da.
story.en: "If we transfer at the next stop, it'll be faster." Haneul, looking out the window, mentioned it offhandedly.

story.text: 버스가 흔들릴 때마다 그는 슬쩍 손잡이 쪽으로 나를 붙잡아 세웠다. 말은 없었지만 손끝이 늘 먼저 움직였다.
story.reading: beo-seu-ga heun-deul-lil ttae-ma-da geu-neun seul-jjeok son-jab-i jjok-eu-ro na-reul but-jab-a se-wot-da. mal-eun eop-seot-ji-man son-kkeut-i neul meon-jeo um-jik-yeot-da.
story.en: Every time the bus swayed, he'd quietly steady me toward the handrail. He never said anything, but his hand always moved first.

story.text: '다음이 우리 내릴 곳이야.' 그가 하차벨을 눌렀다. '내리자.'
story.reading: 'da-eum-i u-ri nae-ril got-i-ya.' geu-ga ha-cha-bel-eul nul-leot-da. 'nae-ri-ja.'
story.en: "This next one's our stop." He pressed the stop button. "Let's get off."

story.text: 버스에서 내려 걷는 길, 하늘이 슬쩍 옆으로 붙었다. '멀지 않았지?' 나는 고개를 끄덕였다. 그와 함께라면 어디든 가깝게 느껴졌다.
story.reading: beo-seu-e-seo nae-ryeo geot-neun gil, ha-neul-i seul-jjeok yeop-eu-ro but-eot-da. 'meol-ji anh-at-ji?' na-neun go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da. geu-wa ham-kke-ra-myeon eo-di-deun ga-kkap-ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da.
story.en: Walking after getting off the bus, Haneul quietly fell into step beside me. "Not too far, right?" I nodded. With him, everywhere felt closer.

words.example_en: This bus goes to Hanok Village.
I'm getting off at the next stop.
Do you have a transit card?
I need to get off at this station.

sentences.en: I'll get off at the next stop.
I'll pay with my transit card.
